当王建新坐车到达公社，天已经黑了。

公社不大，几排土坯房，一个院子，门口挂着木牌子。院子里黑漆漆的，只有几间办公室还亮着灯。吉普车开进院子，停在门口。

王建新从车上下来，没想到的是，赵干事一直在等着他。走廊里亮着灯，赵干事站在办公室门口，身上还穿着白天的中山装，看样子一直没回去。

“赵干事！”王建新赶忙走过去，跟赵干事问好。

赵干事笑着点了点头：“小王同志，路上辛苦了。”

王建新转身打开吉普车的后车门，从里面提出一匹狼肉，递给迎过来的赵干事。然后又从里面拿出两匹狼拎上，一手一匹，沉甸甸的。

“赵干事，昨晚刚打的，正好拿回去给家里改善下伙食。”王建新把手里两匹狼提了提，“这两匹，其中一匹送给书记。听说书记做我的介绍人，我得感谢一下。剩下这一匹，咱们送给食堂，给大家改善改善。”

赵干事接过那匹狼肉，拎在手里，心里很感动。但他还是说道：“小王同志，为什么不留在哨点自己吃呢？现在这肉多金贵。”

王建新乐呵呵地说：“赵干事，我在站点偶尔也能打上黄羊或者狼，隔三差五能吃上肉。再说了，我还有几只羊呢。这是我一点心意，您就收下吧。”

赵干事看着他，沉默了几秒，然后点了点头，不再说什么。

王建新回头又和李班长打了声招呼。李班长在车上朝他摆了摆手，发动车子，开走了。

赵干事带着王建新，两人三匹狼，一起来到书记办公室。

书记办公室在二楼，门开着，灯亮着。刘书记还在加班，这个年月的领导是真的辛苦。他坐在办公桌后面，戴着老花镜，正在看文件，桌上堆着一摞材料。听见敲门声，抬起头，看见赵干事和王建新拎着三匹狼肉站在门口，一下就乐了。

“这是干什么？”刘书记摘下老花镜，站起来，瞅了瞅王建新手上一手一匹狼肉，又看了看赵干事手上那匹，“小王同志，这身手不错啊？这是啥意思？”

王建新笑呵呵地说：“书记，您不是作为我的介绍人吗，我这不是来送礼了吗？”

刘书记笑呵呵地指着他说：“你个小鬼头，哪有这么明目张胆地来送礼啊？”

说完，大家一起笑了起来。

赵干事这时说道：“小王同志带过来三匹狼，这不，送您一匹，送我一匹，所剩下的一匹放在食堂，给工作人员改善下伙食。”

刘书记想了想，说：“行，谢谢小王同志了。”他看了看赵干事，“小赵，先把那匹狼送到食堂，让他们看着处理，明天大家都能吃上一碗狼肉了。”

这个地方，细粮比较珍贵，肉隔三差五的还是能吃上一些。

赵干事把那匹要送去食堂的狼肉拎起来，出了办公室。王建新把剩下的两匹狼肉放在地上。

刘书记热情地招呼王建新坐在沙发上，自己也在旁边的椅子上坐下来。他给王建新倒了杯砖茶，搪瓷缸子，热气腾腾的。

“家里是北京的？”刘书记问。

“是，北京的。”王建新双手接过茶缸子。

“家里都做什么工作的？”

“父亲是钢厂的电工，母亲没工作，在家操持家务。大哥在钢厂开车，二哥在叉车二分厂当工人。”

刘书记点了点头，又问：“成分呢？”

“工人家庭，红五类。”

刘书记满意地点了点头。又问了一些工作情况、学习情况，王建新一一认真回答。刘书记听完了，靠在椅背上，看着王建新，眼神里带着欣赏。

“不错，年轻人有想法，有干劲儿，还立了功。”刘书记说，“等明天，让小赵帮助你提交入团申请。先成为入团积极分子，然后参加三天的教育，我和小赵作为你的培养联系人，对你提供指导和帮助。”

王建新认真地听着。

“三天后便是培养与考察期，在这期间认真学习，条件允许，积极参加团的活动。等考察期过后，团组织会对你进行预审并公示，然后再填写入团志愿书，支部大会讨论并投票表决，通过后报上级团组织批准，再参加入团宣誓后，你就成为了一名光荣的共青团员了。”

王建新没想到入个团的手续还这么复杂。他以为就是写个申请，交上去就行了。没想到还要培养、考察、预审、公示、投票、宣誓，一道一道的，比后世入党还麻烦。

但他心里还是很感激的。在这个年月，成为一名共青团员的分量是很重的。对他以后返城工作有很大的好处。如果表现优异，能入了党，以后就能当一名干部了。

“谢谢书记，我一定好好表现。”王建新站起来，认真地说了句。

刘书记摆了摆手，让他坐下：“坐坐坐，别客气。”

不一会，赵干事回来了。三个人又聊了几句，刘书记便让赵干事带王建新去休息，并让赵干事明天帮助王建新写入团申请书。

“小赵，你帮他把申请书把把关。”刘书记叮嘱道，“写得认真点。”

When Wang Jianxin arrived at the commune by car, it was already dark.

The commune is not big, with a few rows of adobe houses, a courtyard, and a wooden sign hanging at the door.The yard was dark, with only a few offices still lit.The jeep drove into the yard and stopped at the door.

When Wang Jianxin got out of the car, what he didn't expect was that Director Zhao had been waiting for him.The lights were on in the corridor, and Director Zhao was standing at the door of the office, still wearing the tunic suit he wore during the day, and it looked like he had never gone back.

"Director Zhao!" Wang Jianxin hurried over and said hello to Director Zhao.

Director Zhao smiled and nodded: "Comrade Xiao Wang, you have had a hard time on the road."

Wang Jianxin turned around and opened the rear door of the jeep, took out a piece of wolf meat and handed it to Officer Zhao who came over.Then he took out two wolves and carried them up, one in each hand, heavy.

"Director Zhao, I just beat them last night. I just took them back to improve the food for the family." Wang Jianxin raised the two wolves in his hands, "One of the two wolves is given to the secretary. I heard that the secretary was my introducer, so I have to thank you. The remaining one, we will give it to the canteen to improve it for everyone."

Officer Zhao took the wolf meat and held it in his hand, feeling very moved.But he still said: "Comrade Xiao Wang, why don't you stay at the sentry post and eat it by yourself? This meat is very valuable now."

Wang Jianxin said cheerfully: "Director Zhao, I can occasionally hunt goats or wolves at the site, and I can eat meat every now and then. Besides, I still have a few sheep. This is my little wish, please accept it."

Director Zhao looked at him and was silent for a few seconds, then nodded and said nothing more.

Wang Jianxin turned around and said hello to Squad Leader Li again.Squad Leader Li waved to him in the car, started the car, and drove away.

Director Zhao took Wang Jianxin, the two of them and the three wolves together to the secretary's office.

The secretary's office is on the second floor, with the door open and the lights on.Secretary Liu is still working overtime. Leadership in these days is really hard.He was sitting behind his desk, wearing reading glasses and reading documents. There was a pile of materials on the table.Hearing the knock on the door, he raised his head and saw Director Zhao and Wang Jianxin standing at the door carrying three pieces of wolf meat. He was instantly happy.

"What are you doing?" Secretary Liu took off his reading glasses, stood up, and looked at the wolf meat in Wang Jian's new hand, and then at the one in Director Zhao's hand, "Comrade Xiao Wang, this is a good skill? What does this mean?"

Wang Jianxin said with a smile: "Secretary, aren't you acting as my introducer? Am I not here to give you a gift?"

Secretary Liu pointed at him with a smile and said, "You little brat, how can you come here to give gifts so blatantly?"

After saying that, everyone laughed together.

Director Zhao said at this time: "Comrade Xiao Wang has brought over three wolves. One for you and one for me. The remaining one is placed in the canteen to improve the food for the staff."

Secretary Liu thought for a moment and said, "Okay, thank you Comrade Xiao Wang." He looked at Director Zhao and said, "Xiao Zhao, send the wolf to the canteen first and let them watch and deal with it. Everyone can have a bowl of wolf meat tomorrow."

In this place, fine grains are more precious, and you can still eat some meat every now and then.

Director Zhao picked up the wolf meat that was about to be sent to the canteen and left the office.Wang Jianxin placed the remaining two wolf meat on the ground.

Secretary Liu warmly greeted Wang Jianxin to sit on the sofa, and he also sat down on the chair next to him.He poured Wang Jianxin a cup of brick tea in an enamel jar, which was steaming hot.

"Is your family from Beijing?" Secretary Liu asked.

"Yes, from Beijing." Wang Jianxin took the teapot with both hands.

"What kind of work do you do at home?"

"My father is an electrician in a steel factory, and my mother is unemployed and takes care of the housework at home. The eldest brother drives a car in the steel factory, and the second brother works as a worker in the second forklift branch factory."

Secretary Liu nodded and asked, "What are the ingredients?"

"Working family, five red categories."

Secretary Liu nodded with satisfaction.After asking about some work and study situations, Wang Jianxin answered them carefully.After Secretary Liu finished listening, he leaned back in his chair and looked at Wang Jianxin with admiration in his eyes.

"Yes, young people have ideas, are motivated, and have made meritorious deeds." Secretary Liu said, "Wait for tomorrow and let Xiao Zhao help you submit your application for joining the Youth League. Become an active member of the Youth League first, and then participate in three days of education. As your training contact, Xiao Zhao and I will provide you with guidance and help."

Wang Jianxin listened carefully.

"After three days, there will be a training and inspection period. During this period, study hard and, if conditions permit, actively participate in the activities of the group. After the inspection period, the group organization will pre-examine you and make it public. Then you will fill in the application form for joining the group. The branch meeting will discuss and vote on it. After passing it, it will be reported to the superior group organization for approval. After taking the oath of joining the group, you will become a glorious Communist Youth League member."

Wang Jianxin did not expect that the procedures for joining a group would be so complicated.He thought he could just write an application and submit it.Unexpectedly, we have to train, inspect, pre-trial, publicize, vote, and take oaths one by one, which is more troublesome than joining the party in future generations.

But he was still very grateful.In this day and age, becoming a member of the Communist Youth League carries a heavy weight.It will be of great benefit to him when he returns to the city to work in the future.If you perform well and join the party, you can become a cadre in the future.

"Thank you secretary, I will perform well." Wang Jianxin stood up and said seriously.

Secretary Liu waved his hand and told him to sit down: "Sit down, sit down, you're welcome."

After a while, Director Zhao came back.The three of them chatted for a while, and then Secretary Liu asked Director Zhao to take Wang Jianxin to rest, and asked Director Zhao to help Wang Jianxin write the application for the group tomorrow.

"Xiao Zhao, help him check the application form." Secretary Liu warned, "Write it carefully."
